name: Rotate a small object
short_description: Turn a small everyday object through one full rotation using one hand.
self_assessment: I can rotate a small object once in either direction without help.
description: Turn a small everyday object through one full rotation using one hand. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Turn a loose jar lid through one rotation
